title: Python micro pin changes: update the companion test fixtures and version assertions that pin the same version
answers: After changing the default Python patch version in CI, which test fixtures must also change?
Why does an entrypoint assertion on sys.version_info fail after a Python pin bump?
Where are the conda.yaml, python_env.yaml and MLmodel python_version values for test resources?
How do I bump the Python version recorded in model-metadata compatibility tests?
body:
Path: test resource projects under tests/resources (example_virtualenv_project, example_virtualenv_no_python_env, example_virtualenv_conda_project, example_mlflow_1x_sklearn_model) hold python pins in python_env.yaml, conda.yaml, MLmodel, and entrypoint.py version asserts; tests/sklearn/test_sklearn_model_export.py embeds python_version strings inline in test_sklearn_compatible_with_mlflow_2_4_0.
Rule: When the CI Python micro pin moves, change every fixture that records that exact version in the same PR: the python field of python_env.yaml, the python= line of conda.yaml, the python_version flavor entry in MLmodel, the sys.version_info equality assertion in entrypoint.py, and the inline YAML in the sklearn export test. Follow the prior precedent from #23684 for this set.
Constraints: Only fixtures that record the pinned version are touched; the sklearn version assertion (1.4.2) and other library pins stay as they are. Historical model metadata written for older releases should not be rewritten.
applies: Any PR that changes a shared Python micro version pin used by CI test resources and model metadata.
says: Automated test fixtures fail after updating the default Python patch release.
Runtime version assertions fail across sample project environments following a Python upgrade.
Model metadata compatibility tests break when changing the default environment version.
Synchronize environment version definitions across all example test projects during upgrades.
search: When changing the shared CI Python micro version pin, companion test fixtures and assertions recording that exact version must be updated in the same pull request. Affected resources include python_env.yaml, conda.yaml, MLmodel flavor entries, and entrypoint.py sys.version_info asserts in tests/resources sample projects, along with inline YAML in tests/sklearn/test_sklearn_model_export.py:test_sklearn_compatible_with_mlflow_2_4_0. Applies only to fixtures recording the pinned Python version following the precedent from #23684; library pins like sklearn 1.4.2 and historical model metadata from older releases remain unchanged.
